trials.claim: Lifetime access to Vocal Pro or Business Plan
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Vocal Pro or Business Plan
trials.reasoning: Buyers report buying the lifetime deal in 2023 and still using it, and contrast monthly pricing with being in for a lifetime. The license and breach-termination terms are standard conditions and do not undercut that lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: The Nat Services are owned by Nat and are licensed, not sold, to you.
exhibits.argument: The deal grants only a revocable license, not owned lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: These Terms will automatically terminate when you fail to comply with any term or condition of these Terms.
exhibits.argument: Access can be automatically terminated, which voids any lifetime promise.

exhibits.quote: I purchased Vocal back in 2023 when it was first offered as an LTD here on AppSumo and to this day, it's one of the BEST purchases I've made.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms purchasing as LTD in 2023 and still using it, supporting lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: compared to the monthly pricing, I'm glad I'm in for a lifetime.
exhibits.argument: Buyer contrasts monthly pricing with being in for a lifetime, supporting lifetime access.

trials.claim: Send as many messages as you want
trials.claimQuote:
Send voice messages from Gmail or Outlook (+ our web app)
- Send as many messages as you want
- Unlimited recording time
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms an unlimited number of recordings. The generic reference to reasonable limitations does not show any actual limit on messages.

exhibits.quote: Nat Services are subject to reasonable limitations and other limitations, as specified within the Nat Services or the applicable Order Form(s).
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to impose limitations, contradicting unlimited messages.

exhibits.quote: PS. A big plus for the unlimited number of recordings.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms unlimited number of recordings, supporting send as many messages as you want.

trials.claimQuote:
Send as many messages as you want
- Unlimited recording time
- Voice contact form for your website
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports longer audio fails with an upload error, which materially limits the promised unlimited recording time despite another review mentioning long files.

exhibits.quote: Nat Services are subject to reasonable limitations and other limitations, as specified within the Nat Services or the applicable Order Form(s).
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to impose limitations, contradicting unlimited recording time.

exhibits.quote: I love the website but longer Audio having a problem saying error uploading the audio ...but other than that its great software.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports longer audio fails to upload, undermining unlimited recording time.

exhibits.quote: what impressed me is how fast it takes to transcribe very long audio files.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms handling very long audio files, supporting unlimited recording time.

trials.claim: All future plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote:
You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
- Send voice messages from Gmail or Outlook (+ our web app)
trials.reasoning: No exhibit shows deal buyers actually receiving all future plan updates. The terms only say updates are not obligated and fees may change, which neither proves nor directly contradicts inclusion if updates are released.

exhibits.quote: Nat reserves the right but is not obligated to improve, enhance or modify the Nat Services.
exhibits.argument: The vendor has no obligation to provide any future updates.

exhibits.quote: Nat reserves the right to change the Fee Schedule upon thirty (30) days advanced notice to you.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can change pricing, undermining that future plan updates are included.

trials.claim: Send voice messages from Gmail or Outlook plus web app
trials.claimQuote: Send voice messages from Gmail or Outlook (+ our web app)
trials.reasoning: The vendor states Vocal works in Gmail and Outlook, and a buyer confirms it works directly within Gmail or Outlook.

exhibits.quote: Vocal works where you work (Gmail, Outlook). No need to learn a new tool.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the product works in Gmail and Outlook, supporting the claim.

exhibits.quote: Does seem to work best at this point directly within Gmail or in Outlook.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms it works directly within Gmail or Outlook, supporting the claim.

trials.claim: Voice contact form for your website is included
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited recording time
- Voice contact form for your website
- Add custom Call-To-Action (CTA) to your voice message page
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm creating a website embed for voice notes and adding voice messaging to a contact form so visitors can leave messages.

exhibits.quote: Besides Gmail, I've also created an embed to use for people on my website to respond or send voice notes to me.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms creating a website embed for visitors to send voice notes, supporting voice contact form.

exhibits.quote: My favorite feature though is the ability for people to leave ME a message. I added it to my contact form and instead of filling out a form people will leave a voice message.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms adding voice messaging to contact form, supporting voice contact form inclusion.

themes.summary: Many buyers say Vocal makes communication faster, easier and more personal with accurate transcription.

The interface is easy to use and I can set everything up in less than 15 minutes

The app works easily amd they have very good customer service
